races.paceDynamic: Digital will be the lone front runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable tempo with no early pressure. Stanley Spencer, Hundred Caps, and Mr Lightside will track in behind but are unlikely to challenge for the lead early. The lack of pace pressure means Digital can dictate fractions and kick when ready, while the hold-up horses (Dorney Lake, Musical Touch, Cajetan, King's Crown, Way To Dubai, Palmarian) will have ground to make up. This setup strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers — the pace will be controlled and those tracking the leader are ideally positioned to strike.

races.paceDynamic: Folk Pageant will take them along from the front with no early pressure, setting a comfortable tempo in the opening half-mile. The real danger comes at the two-furlong pole where Tewkesbury, Haddiah, Hardstyle and Booziebrunch all converge from prominent positions, creating significant traffic problems. What's The Plan, Ebn Sabt and Boy Named Sioux will be working their way through from the back as the field compresses. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — Folk Pageant's uncontested early lead will create a genuine pace, and the prominent congestion will open up gaps for closers to exploit late.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet bunch up behind Folk Pageant approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows What's The Plan and Ebn Sabt to sweep through with clear runs. Their superior class tells in a driving finish where positioning proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic sorts itself cleanly
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners find racing room without interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Hardstyle's strong recent form and Tewkesbury's consistency see them battle it out from their forward positions. The pace stays honest but manageable for those placed handy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire upset
scenarios.trigger: If Folk Pageant is allowed an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front runner builds an unassailable advantage before the field can organize a challenge. Sean Bowen times the move perfectly as the others get in each other's way behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Folk Pageant stops dramatically and the prominent runners come to a standstill
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole with no genuine pace throughout. Boy Named Sioux's tactical speed from the back proves the decisive weapon in a messy finish.

races.paceDynamic: Arlington will break fast and likely lead from gate to wire as the sole confirmed front runner in this field. With no other natural pace-setters, Arlington can dictate fractions and cruise through comfortable splits without early pressure. The large field of hold-up horses including Little Mi Mi, Auntie Jo, Silky Robin, and Okami will be bunched behind the leader, creating a compressed pack that will need to find racing room in the straight. This setup strongly favours the front runner and any prominent racers who can secure good early positions — the tactical advantage of a clear lead without pressure is decisive over this sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: Arlington controls the tempo throughout and kicks clear when challenged, while the hold-up brigade gets into traffic trouble behind the pace. The clean run and sustainable fractions give the leader a decisive tactical edge.

scenarios.body: The compressed field allows talented hold-up horses to unleash devastating finishing kicks once clear running appears. Superior class tells as Arlington's early advantage evaporates.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Street Life or Colors Of Freedom secure ideal stalking positions behind Arlington.
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get first run on the leader while avoiding the traffic problems that befall the hold-up horses further back. Perfect tactical positioning trumps raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Arlington goes too fast early or breaks poorly from the stalls.
scenarios.body: Chaos ensues with no clear pace narrative, allowing an outsider to capitalize on the confusion and slip through late. Random factors decide the outcome.
